summary: Master Business Process Re-engineering and BPMN 2.0. Learn radical redesign, process mining, and automation to drive operational excellence. Enroll today.
lede: Business process re-engineering helps process analysts and transformation professionals map end-to-end work and identify opportunities for redesign. Training covers current- and future-state BPMN models, bottleneck and root-cause analysis, and process ownership and control assessment. Participants also practise prioritizing automation opportunities and defining performance measures and implementation steps for stakeholder review.
audienceIntro: This advanced business process mapping course is designed for professionals who already work with operational workflows, process governance, transformation portfolios, or enterprise architecture and need to lead complex redesign initiatives.
prerequisites: You should have practical experience documenting, managing, improving, or governing business processes. Familiarity with workflow diagrams, operational KPIs, and cross-functional process ownership is expected. No programming is required. The course teaches AI-assisted process discovery, process mining, and automation assessment at an operational application level rather than technical engineering or software deployment depth. Bring a laptop if possible.
